_comment: Maps mcad/esp-box-emu-3.step occurrences to the box-3-connector board.
Calibration (2026-07-10): the Fusion 'Box-3 Electronics' board component
uses the Eagle v11 brd coordinate frame; the BOX_3_EMU outline footprint
matches the Eagle v11 outline exactly (18/18 vertices, 0.0000 mm rms) at
kx = ex - 50.4579, ky = 70.0000 - ey. The TE connector footprint's pad
layout matches the Eagle package exactly (A1 at local -9.5,0), so no
offset is needed; the r180 from CAD is meaningful (it puts pad A1 on the
correct side to mate with the box dock, as on the manufactured board).
